source: Existing saved offline base-policy prediction; no task LoRA, steering, or robot execution.
retargeting: Existing saved Wuji joint/root poses from the project analytical retargeter with filtering disabled. No new retargeting.

display.timing: First pose at +0.1 s, remaining poses every 0.3 s through +4.3 s. First and last states hold briefly at video boundaries.

display.camera_materials: Original Wuji teaser renderer camera, lights, materials, and geometry; 2x supersampling with alpha-aware downsampling.
display.distinction_from_previous_video: The previous video advances through 80 observation anchors, displaying future poses 0/7/14 together. This clip advances through all 15 future poses from one fixed anchor.
